title: envhaul configuration
description: Defines the .env files envhaul generates and where each value comes from. See https://davidtucker.github.io/envhaul/config/

name.description: Environment name, e.g. dev or staging. Shown in generated file headers.

aws_profile.description: Default AWS profile for references without @profile. Overridden by --profile.

aws_region.description: AWS region for every request. Overridden by --region. When unset, each profile's own region is used.

ssm_prefix.description: Prefix joined onto SSM paths that do not start with /. Must start with /.

secret_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to Secrets Manager ids that are not ARNs.

vault.description: HashiCorp Vault / OpenBao settings for {{vault:...}} references.

onepassword.description: 1Password settings for {{op:...}} references (read through the op CLI).

gcp.description: Google Cloud Secret Manager settings for {{gcp:...}} references.

azure.description: Azure Key Vault settings for {{azkv:...}} references.

components.description: Each component produces one env file.

description.description: Free-form description, shown in shell completion.

env_file.description: Path of the generated file, relative to this config file.

vars.description: Variables in output order. Values are inline text or templates with {{scheme:path[#key][@profile][|fn[:arg]]}} references.

address.description: Vault address, e.g. https://vault.example.com. Defaults to $VAULT_ADDR.

namespace.description: Vault Enterprise / OpenBao namespace. Defaults to $VAULT_NAMESPACE.

mount.description: KV secrets engine mount for paths without a leading /. Defaults to secret.

kv_version.description: KV secrets engine version. Defaults to 2.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the token. Defaults to $VAULT_TOKEN, then ~/.vault-token.

profiles.description: Named profiles selected with @name. A profile's settings override the defaults above; @name with no matching profile is used as the namespace.

kv_version.description: KV secrets engine version. Defaults to 2.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the token. Defaults to $VAULT_TOKEN, then ~/.vault-token.

account.description: 1Password account (sign-in address, email or account ID) passed to op --account. Defaults to op's default account.

profiles.description: Named profiles selected with @name. @name with no matching profile is used as the account.

account.description: 1Password account (sign-in address, email or account ID) passed to op --account. Defaults to op's default account.

project.description: Project ID for secret names that aren't full resource names. Defaults to $GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT or the credentials' project.

impersonate_service_account.description: Service account email to impersonate with your Application Default Credentials.

profiles.description: Named profiles selected with @name. @name with no matching profile is used as the project ID.

tenant.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID to authenticate against.

vault.description: Default key vault name for references without a vault/ prefix.

vault_dns_suffix.description: Key Vault DNS suffix for sovereign clouds. Defaults to vault.azure.net.
